notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny is Coming to You This September!
[previewyoutube="yRspOjir6aA;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone! We’re excited to finally share that Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny will be releasing on September 25, 2025 (GMT+7)!

It’s been a long journey getting the game ready, and we can’t wait for you to experience it for yourself. Thank you so much for sticking with us and supporting the project—it really means the world to the team.

Make sure to wishlist and follow the game here on Steam so you’ll get notified when it goes live. 



We hope you're ready to face the destiny.



With love,

Digital Happiness :DH

notes.title: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny Demo Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny has been updated to build 19226344, with changes:

polished several 2D asset textures

We hope this adds to your enjoyment in trying Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny. Thank you for checking this out!

notes.content:

notes.title: DEMO Now Available for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny Demo is here![previewyoutube="b0qht2h1i4U;full"][/previewyoutube]You're invited!
Let's celebrate Steam Next Fest with the very first hands-on DEMO of Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny!

This is your first chance to explore the world of Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny.


Make sure you're heard
If you enjoy the experience, please consider leaving us a review and adding the game to your Wishlist. Your feedback and support mean everything to us at this stage. It will help us refine and develop Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny into the best version it can be.



Thank you for playing! We can’t wait to hear what you think.



Best,

:DH

notes.title: DHXP 2025 Anniversary event
notes.content:
Thank you for sticking with us all these years!

It's been over a decade since we began this journey, as this month marks eleven years of Digital Happiness' first-ever launched title, DreadOut. What started as a small spark has grown into a world of stories and shared memories with you, our beloved players.

Everything we've built was made with passion, sleepless nights, and LOTS of coffee. And through it all, you've been there playing, supporting, and believing in us.

DHXP is the pulse of everything we’ve created so far. And to this day, it has always been more than a celebration, it’s a thank you, a look back, and a vision of what lies ahead.

And for you, thank you for being part of this journey. Whether you’ve been here since the beginning, or you just stumbled into our world someway somehow, we're glad you're here.

Then what lies beyond the 11th year?

This is the fun part. Currently, there are so many things going on in our headquarters, and we're so excited to share them with you. We're working on titles that you might have expected and not expected!

[previewyoutube=uYlkB3py6EE;full][/previewyoutube]

Also check out the DHXP 2025 Steam Sale Page by clicking the banner below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371531/f6f256432d7ba3a4c98fa44749cb058a7bd9463e.jpg

Did someone mention sale?
Of course, we have a special sale going on too! Take a look around and dive into the games that have shaped us as a developers. You can get it with up to 80% off!

Please spread the news because this offer lasts through May 24, 2025!

Hope you enjoy every bit of it!

:DH
